claim_001.label: SUPPORTED
claim_001.text: When an unsupported proxy protocol is supplied, the raised ValueError includes the evaluated representation of proxy.url.scheme instead of displaying the literal placeholder text.

evidence.note: The frozen diff changes the second error-message fragment from a normal string to an f-string, causing proxy.url.scheme to be evaluated.

claim_001.rationale: The error-message interpolation behavior follows directly from the one-line frozen source change.

claim_002.label: SUPPORTED
claim_002.text: The change was made so that the actual proxy protocol scheme is displayed in the error message.

evidence.note: The commit message states: Display proxy protocol scheme on error.
The pull-request summary says that the change evaluates proxy.url.scheme in the error message.

claim_002.rationale: The commit title, pull-request title, and pull-request summary explicitly identify displaying the evaluated scheme in the error message as the purpose of the change.

claim_003.label: UNSUPPORTED
claim_003.text: The change was primarily introduced to improve HTTPX proxy performance.
claim_003.rationale: The frozen diff only changes error-message interpolation, and the commit and pull-request evidence do not mention a performance objective.

claim_004.label: UNSUPPORTED
claim_004.text: The change adds support for a new proxy protocol scheme.
claim_004.rationale: The accepted proxy protocol list is unchanged. The frozen change only renders the rejected scheme value in the error message.
